'''World generation''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] uses the vanilla terrain, but the pack changes biomes, ores, structures and dimension settings so that the world feels older, emptier and more dangerous. Most changes only appear in newly generated chunks.

== Terrain and biomes ==
{{Main|Biomes}}
* 65 biomes are overridden: [[Husk]]s spawn nearly everywhere, colors are changed, and the Pale Garden has no hostile mobs.
* Beaches have blue orchids and cornflowers; deserts have no flowers.

== Ores ==
{{See also|Ores}}
* [[Native Silver]] (emerald ore) generates rarely in almost every biome deep underground, and more often in mountains.
* [[Quartz Deposit]]s (lapis ore) are six times as common and reach Y=96.
* Very large [[Coal Deposit]] veins generate at deepslate level under deserts.

== Structures ==
{{Main|Structures}}
* New: the [[Abbey]].
* Replaced: villages became [[abandoned village]]s and pillager outposts became [[Papal Outpost]]s.
* Changed: [[Dungeon]]s are more common and their spawner mobs drop nothing; the [[Igloo]] and a [[Woodland Mansion]] room are changed; almost every chest loot table is changed (see [[Chest loot]]).

== Dimensions ==
{{Main|Dimensions}}
* The Overworld uses "true darkness".
* The Nether is called [[Hell]]. It has no gravel, has natural [[Hellspore]], and water emptied from a bucket below its roof is removed.
